bio_en: Minas Tonikian, known as Vardan Shahpaz, was a native of Divrik of modest education, short, bright-eyed, silent and daring. Like many young villagers he went to Constantinople in 1890 to earn money, where his friend Sargis Chopurian introduced him to the 'patriots', and in 1896 he took part in the seizure of the Ottoman Bank, which he later described in his memoir. In autumn 1902 he reached Van via Persia; after Vardges was betrayed and arrested, his first task was to find the traitor, who was struck down eight days later by his trusted Tsur Davo. He later lived for many years in Beirut, where he died on 8 June at the age of 95.
